en.text: Be merciful to me, God, be merciful to me, for my soul takes refuge in you. in the shadow of your wings, I will take refuge, has passed.

zhSimplified.text: 神啊，求你怜悯我，怜悯我！

zhTraditional.text: 上帝啊，求你憐憫我，憐憫我！

en.text: I cry out to God Most High, to God who accomplishes my requests for me.

zhSimplified.text: 我要求告至高的 神， 的 神。

zhTraditional.text: 我要求告至高的上帝， 的上帝。

en.text: He will send from heaven, and save me, he rebukes the one who is pursuing me. will send out his loving kindness and his truth.

zhSimplified.text: 那要吞我的人辱骂我的时候，

zhTraditional.text: 那要吞我的人辱罵我的時候，

en.text: My soul is among lions. I lie among those who are set on fire, the sons of men, whose teeth are spears and arrows, and their tongue a sharp sword.
Be exalted, God, above the heavens! Let your glory be above all the earth!

zhSimplified.text: 神啊，愿你崇高过于诸天！

zhTraditional.text: 上帝啊，願你崇高過於諸天！

en.text: They have prepared a net for my steps. My soul is bowed down. They dig a pit before me. They fall into the middle of it themselves.

zhSimplified.text: 他们为我的脚设下网罗，压制我的心；

zhTraditional.text: 他們為我的腳設下網羅，壓制我的心；

en.text: My heart is steadfast, God. My heart is steadfast. I will sing, yes, I will sing praises.

zhSimplified.text: 神啊，我心坚定，我心坚定；

zhTraditional.text: 上帝啊，我心堅定，我心堅定；

en.text: Wake up, my glory! Wake up, lute and harp! I will wake up the dawn.
I will give thanks to you, Lord, among the peoples. I will sing praises to you among the nations.

zhSimplified.text: 主啊，我要在万民中称谢你，

zhTraditional.text: 主啊，我要在萬民中稱謝你，

en.text: For your great loving kindness reaches to the heavens, and your truth to the skies.

zhSimplified.text: 因为，你的慈爱高及诸天；

zhTraditional.text: 因為，你的慈愛高及諸天；

en.text: Be exalted, God, above the heavens. your glory be over all the earth.

zhSimplified.text: 神啊，愿你崇高过于诸天！

zhTraditional.text: 上帝啊，願你崇高過於諸天！
